Container.Name: Stashboard
Container.Overview: Discover scenes on StashDB or FansDB, request them in Whisparr, follow each request into your Stash library, and watch from the same app on your phone or desktop.[br][br]Needs a PostgreSQL 15 or newer database: install the PostgreSQL app from Community Applications first (for example postgresql17), create a database and user for Stashboard, then fill in the Database fields below. Setup in the web UI connects Stash, Whisparr and the catalog.
Container.Requires: A PostgreSQL 15+ database (for example the postgresql17 app from Community Applications).

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: The port you open Stashboard on.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Session secret, logs and the image cache. Give Stashboard a folder of its own.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Optional. The same media folder Stash and Whisparr use, mapped to the same path they see, so renames and empty-folder cleanup work.

Config.Name: Database host
Config.Description: Your server's IP. The PostgreSQL container's name works only when both containers are on the same custom Docker network.

Config.Name: Database name
Config.Description: The database Stashboard uses. It creates its tables on first start.

Config.Name: Database user
Config.Description: A PostgreSQL user that owns that database.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User Stashboard runs as. 99 is Unraid's nobody, which owns media by default.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group Stashboard runs as. 100 is Unraid's users group.

Config.Name: Setup code
Config.Description: Optional. When set, creating the first admin account also needs this code, so nobody who reaches a fresh install first can claim it.

Config.Name: Secure cookies
Config.Description: Leave empty to mark the sign-in cookie Secure whenever you visit over HTTPS. true or false forces it.

Config.Name: Trust proxy
Config.Description: Behind a reverse proxy, set to 1 (one proxy in front) or the proxy's address or network, such as 172.18.0.0/16, so login throttling sees each visitor's real address. Then let only the proxy reach this port.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: error, warn, info, debug or trace. Settings, Logs can also change it while running.
